pages.title: Offline knowledge archive
pages.summary: Collect evidence-backed notes with tags and source URLs
pages.tags: knowledge, Title, Source URL, Evidence category, Summary
pages.specialty: Explore explicit [[Title]] references, duplicate source URLs, and records that lack independently traceable sources. Links are textual references, not automatic evidence verification.
pages.acceptance_test: Test resolved and unresolved [[Title]] references; duplicate URLs; export coverage JSON

pages.title: Edible garden planner
pages.summary: Plan edible planting beds and quantities
pages.tags: product, Crop, Area (m²), Estimated yield (kg/m²), Planting date
pages.specialty: Calculate per-crop estimates from your own area × assumed yield. This is a scenario calculator, not a biological prediction or planting recommendation.
pages.acceptance_test: Add two crops, adjust area budget, validate each area × assumption, export numerical CSV

pages.title: Learning quest builder
pages.summary: Create learning activities with practical completion evidence
pages.tags: effort, Quest, Minutes, Difficulty, Proof of learning
pages.specialty: Complete quests explicitly and earn illustrative game points only after a learning-evidence description exists. This does not assess skill or award credentials.
pages.acceptance_test: Complete evidence-backed quest, reject empty evidence, check persisted completion and transcript

pages.title: Offline field survey
pages.summary: Log observations with method and sampling context
pages.tags: measure, Site label (not private address), Sample ID, Reading, Unit, Method / calibration
pages.specialty: Check sample-identifier duplicates, group numerical observations strictly by their units, and flag missing methods. No cross-unit averaging.
pages.acceptance_test: Repeat sample ID, mix units, confirm separate statistics and CSV matches records

pages.title: Evidence provenance ledger
pages.summary: Separate assertions, sources and verification status
pages.tags: evidence, Assertion, Source / identifier, Review status, Method / limits
pages.specialty: Display disputed/unverified claims first and identify missing sources. A status label is a human entry; the tool never establishes truth by itself.
pages.acceptance_test: Flag disputed claim, verify sort order, source gaps and Markdown export

pages.title: Household resilience checklist
pages.summary: Plan essentials without making safety guarantees
pages.tags: inventory, Preparedness item, Quantity, Priority, Storage location
pages.specialty: Identify missing quantities and sort optional procurement notes by user-assigned priority; this does not measure emergency readiness.
pages.acceptance_test: Sort high/medium/low, flag zero counts, inspect procurement export

pages.title: Community decision register
pages.summary: Document options, consent and procedural outcomes
pages.tags: governance, Proposal, Affected stakeholders, Stage, Conditions / notes
pages.specialty: Surface proposals and their stated participants/conditions. Recording Approved is not evidence of consent or lawful process.
pages.acceptance_test: Stage filter and recorded stakeholder fields change output; export decision minutes

pages.title: Geographic observation notebook
pages.summary: Record field locations as labeled coordinates
pages.tags: map, Place label, Latitude, Longitude, Observation
pages.specialty: Compute great-circle distances between two recorded observations on a spherical Earth approximation; not a navigational route.
pages.acceptance_test: Add two known coordinates, calculate plausible distance, reject >90 lat, verify GeoJSON lon/lat

pages.title: Interactive story studio
pages.summary: Track characters, motives and evolving symbols
pages.tags: story, Character, What they want, Consequence, Recurring symbol
pages.specialty: Show which symbols recur across characters, then export a reproducible writing brief anchored to the actual records—not a generic AI-generated story.
pages.acceptance_test: Add recurring motif across characters; verify counts and story bible

pages.title: Accessible audio journal
pages.summary: Organize audio session records and transcripts
pages.tags: effort, Session title, Duration (minutes), Transcript / notes, Sharing
pages.specialty: Inspect transcript length and explicitly marked sharing preferences. Open a local audio file for playback without uploading it or saving it in the journal.
pages.acceptance_test: Add transcript, count words, load local audio and verify no network upload

pages.title: Portable dataset explorer
pages.summary: Store labeled measurements and compare records
pages.tags: measure, Data point, Value, Unit, Uncertainty ±
pages.specialty: Separate observations by identical unit strings; show arithmetic means and an uncertainty illustration assuming independent, uncorrelated reported ± values.
pages.acceptance_test: Add incompatible units and two points with ±; confirm separated means and propagated uncertainty

pages.title: Accessibility audit board
pages.summary: Record test results and necessary remedies
pages.tags: audit, Component, Criterion, Result, Remediation
pages.specialty: Prioritize human-recorded failures and manual-review items. This interface does not certify WCAG conformance.
pages.acceptance_test: Create fail and manual-review records, check defect order and CSV

pages.title: Privacy impact workbench
pages.summary: Document collection purposes and reduction options
pages.tags: privacy, Data collected, Purpose, Necessity, Retention rule
pages.specialty: Translate the user-assigned necessity labels into explicit keep/reconsider/remove queues and identify unspecified retention rules.
pages.acceptance_test: Label three data elements as Remove/Optional/Essential and verify inventory export

pages.title: Data exchange hub
pages.summary: Create traceable dataset exchange packages
pages.tags: exchange, Dataset, Schema version, Reuse license, Source and rights
pages.specialty: Package dataset names, versions, reuse licenses, and source statements. Generate SHA-256 when Web Crypto is available; a digest does not prove the contents are true.
pages.acceptance_test: Create manifest, inspect entry hash or explicit unsupported reason, compare exported entries

pages.title: Collaboration planning studio
pages.summary: Track participants, tasks and consent-based assignments
pages.tags: workflow, Shared task, Owner alias, State, Handoff details
pages.purpose_workbench: Local task board with controlled transitions
pages.specialty: Move local task cards through Open → In progress → Review → Done. This is not cross-user real-time synchronization.
pages.acceptance_test: Create task, advance to Done, reopen, reload state and export handoff CSV

pages.title: Restoration monitoring dashboard
pages.summary: Track baselines and repeat observations
pages.tags: delta, Plot / site, Baseline, Latest measurement, Measured indicator
pages.specialty: Compare repeated observations within the same indicator. Positive change is not necessarily ecological improvement; direction depends on the indicator.
pages.acceptance_test: Add paired positive and negative changes, mixed indicators, zero baseline and check CSV

pages.title: Scientific calculation notebook
pages.summary: Record quantities and explicit assumptions
pages.tags: product, Experiment, Input value, Conversion / multiplier, Assumptions
pages.specialty: Recalculate saved input × multiplier with stated assumptions. Separately, use a small deterministic conversion library with explicit unit pairs.
pages.acceptance_test: Test 0°C → 32°F, 1m → 3.281ft, and stored arithmetic independently

pages.title: AI evaluation notebook
pages.summary: Record reproducible tests and human findings
pages.tags: audit, Test case, Expected behavior, Observed behavior, Outcome
pages.specialty: List expected vs observed output next to the user-recorded outcome. The system never auto-generates a pass or pretends to run a model.
pages.acceptance_test: Add pass/fail/uncertain entries, verify denominator excludes uncertain and CSV is correct

pages.title: Deployment readiness board
pages.summary: Track site release requirements and evidence
pages.tags: audit, Release check, Area, State, Verification method
pages.specialty: Inspect each release area for at least one verified check with a nonempty proof statement. A passing checklist is not a security certification.
pages.acceptance_test: Test empty areas block gate, then verify all five with proof; export report

pages.title: Emergency kit inventory
pages.summary: Maintain a portable inventory without implying professional advice
pages.tags: inventory, Supply, Quantity, Expiry date, Storage and checks
pages.specialty: Flag stored items with expired or near-term dates, separately from counts. Dates are compared using calendar dates, not clinical safety guidance.
pages.acceptance_test: Add expired and future items; adjust horizon; check date arithmetic and exported flags

pages.title: Regenerative career map
pages.summary: Organize occupations, training and transferable capabilities
pages.tags: effort, Occupation, Transferable skill, Training hours (estimate), Credential or source
pages.specialty: Group occupations by user-entered transferable skills and sort training-hour estimates; entries are not verified job postings or recognized credentials.
pages.acceptance_test: Create two occupations with same skill, verify grouped crosswalk and ordered roadmap

pages.title: Open publication desk
pages.summary: Track article source, licensing and review readiness
pages.tags: publishing, Publication title, Author / attribution, License / permissions, Review state
pages.specialty: Check author attribution, rights statement, and user-entered review state before exporting draft Article JSON-LD. Exporting metadata does not publish a document.
pages.acceptance_test: Test Draft blocked; Ready with author/license exports valid JSON-LD but does not publish
